name: orkestra
description: Cost-aware multi-agent orchestration for Claude Code: a conductor plans and decides, each part goes to the right model, the other vendor reviews it, cheap agents verify. Evidence-based verdicts, anti-Goodhart rules, token measurement.

codex_model.title: Codex model
codex_model.description: Model passed to `codex exec -m` for writing, reviewing and diagnosis. Use the strongest Codex model your plan allows. Leave empty and the conductor asks once.

codex_model_light.title: Light Codex model (optional)
codex_model_light.description: A cheaper Codex model for mechanical parts (docs, config, renames). Leave empty and those parts go to a Haiku worker instead.

codex_model_design.title: Design Codex model (optional)
codex_model_design.description: A stronger Codex model for design work: concepts, image generation, and 2D/3D model or asset tuning. Simple visual polish stays on codex_model. Leave empty and design work uses codex_model.

gemini_model.title: Gemini model (optional)
gemini_model.description: Model passed to Google's CLI (`agy --model`, or `gemini -m`) when it writes or reviews. Only needed if you use it. Leave empty to use the CLI's own default.
